stages.what: 6 rendered camera images (uint8 RGB), the ego's world pose
3-D boxes in the ego frame: x, y, z, l, w, h, yaw, vx, vy + class + occluded
ego2img = K [R | t] per camera (BEVFormer's lidar2img)
stride 8, 64 channels, trained with the model

stages.note: 1.44 M params, identical to PyTorch within 2e-5

stages.what: 32x32 cells of 2 m, each lifted to 4 heights (0.4, 1.0, 1.6, 2.6) m
pillar points -> every camera's feature map; a camera is a hit view if any point lands in it
previous BEV warped by the ego motion (R, t) into the current frame
stages.note: ego moved 1.18 m, turned 0.0 deg; label heatmaps correlate 0.72 unwarped -> 0.90 warped

stages.what: 2 x (temporal self-attn -> spatial cross-attn -> FFN), 4 heads, 64 channels
class heatmaps + 10 regression channels per cell
Gaussian heatmaps at object centres (focal loss) + L1 regression where mask = 1
3x3 peak picking -> boxes; nuScenes-style mAP / NDS
stages.note: labels -> targets -> decode round trip: mAP 1.00, NDS 1.00 (must be 1.00)

stages.what: overfit one batch of 4 pairs for 80 steps (plumbing, not training)
